en.title: Pete Hegseth to hold first Pentagon briefing since May amid impeachment threat
en.dek: Defense Secretary Hegseth faces an impeachment resolution as he prepares his first Pentagon briefing in six months.
facts: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is scheduled to give his first Pentagon news conference in six months on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.
Republican Representative Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against Hegseth on Monday, November 9, 2026, citing his handling of the war against Iran and other actions.
The impeachment resolution focuses on the war in Iran but also references military actions in Yemen against Houthi rebels and operations in Venezuela.
President Donald Trump has publicly backed Hegseth, asserting that military operations against Iran have 'obliterated' its navy and air force.
Hegseth has defended his stewardship, telling reporters he is ready to defend his and President Trump's actions from 'politically motivated people.'
body: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is scheduled to give his first news conference from the Pentagon in six months on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. The briefing comes just one day after Republican Representative Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against him.

Mr. Hegseth, who has said the news conference would focus on the impeachment threat, is gearing up for a fight, having launched a social media blitz and stating he is ready to defend his and President Donald Trump's actions from 'politically motivated people.' Representative Massie filed the impeachment resolution on Monday, November 9, 2026, arguing that Hegseth's actions amount to 'high crimes and misdemeanors.'

President Donald Trump has publicly backed Hegseth, pointing to the raid to capture then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in January and military operations against Iran that he asserts have 'obliterated' its navy and air force. However, Iran has been able to keep striking U.S. military bases in West Asia and has disrupted shipping in the Strait of Hormuz during the more than eight-month-old conflict.
en.context: Republican Representative Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Monday, November 9, 2026, citing his handling of the war against Iran and other actions, just days after Republicans suffered sweeping losses in last week's midterm elections that many blamed on the Iran conflict.

zh.title: 赫格塞思出任国防部长后首次五角大楼简报，面临弹劾威胁
zh.dek: 赫格塞思国防部长将在六个月后首次在五角大楼举行简报，面临一项弹劾决议
facts: 国防部长赫格塞思定于2026年11月10日（周二）举行六个月后首次五角大楼新闻发布会。共和党众议员托马斯·马西于2026年11月9日提交针对赫格塞思的弹劾案，指责其对伊朗战争的处理及其他行动。弹劾决议聚焦伊朗战争，同时也提及针对也门胡塞武装的军事行动以及委内瑞拉行动。特朗普总统公开支持赫格塞思，声称针对伊朗的军事行动已‘粉碎’其海军和空军。赫格塞思已辩护自己的履职情况，告知记者他已准备好向‘有政治动机的人’辩护自己的及总统特朗普的行动。
马西于2026年11月9日提交弹劾案，聚焦伊朗战争及其他行动
特朗普公开支持赫格塞思，称军事行动‘粉碎’伊朗海军和空军
赫格塞思称准备好向‘有政治动机的人’辩护行动
body: 国防部长皮特·赫格塞思将于2026年11月10日星期二在五角大楼举行首次新闻发布会，这已是六个月来首次。此次简报仅在共和党众议员托马斯·马斯提于前一天提交针对他的弹劾文章之后进行。
赫格塞思表示，此次新闻发布会的重点将集中在弹劾威胁上，他正在做好迎战准备，已发动社交媒体攻势，并表示已准备好为其与唐纳德·特朗普总统的行动辩护，以应对“政治动机”的人。马斯提众议员于2026年11月9日星期一提交了弹劾决议，指控赫格塞思的行为构成“严重违法和职务不当行为”。
特朗普总统公开支持赫格塞思，他援引去年一月捕获当时委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的行动，以及他断言已“粉碎”伊朗海军和空军的军事行动。然而，伊朗在此期间继续袭击美国在西亚的军事基地，并扰乱霍尔木兹海峡的航运，该冲突已超过八个月。
zh.context: 共和党众议员托马斯·马西于2026年11月9日提交针对国防部长赫格塞思的弹劾案，指责其对伊朗战争的处理及其他行动，此举恰逢共和党在上周的中期选举中遭受重大失利，许多选民将这些失利归咎于伊朗冲突。 || 2026年11月9日，国会 || 马西指责赫格塞思对伊朗战争处理不当 || 选举失利被归咎于伊朗冲突 @@CAPTION||
